purpose: Validate new live-aircraft diagnostics and verify that read-only logging leaves one real PPO update sequence unchanged.
budget_interpretation: One complete rollout; the live_steps=1 request intentionally finishes that rollout and reports its exact actual experience.
numerical_validation: Same full initial and final policy tensors, saved optimizer state, experience and optimization counters.
Live diagnostic sample count equals completed live experience; padded slots are excluded.
Critic-fit and action-box diagnostics are finite, or explained variance is explicitly undefined for constant returns.
Both source snapshots remain unchanged and completed training audits pass.
resource_gate: Run one simulator at a time after the SAC reference evaluator exits.
